sql: select v.version, ep.epoch_number, ep.started_at::text as epoch_started, ep.ended_at::text as epoch_ended, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.stage, d.ended_at::text as dep_ended, a.arm_key, a.strategy_tag from experiment_versions v join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id left join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=v.id left join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id=ep.id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id=d.id where e.key='mmsell-price-ceiling' order by v.version, ep.epoch_number, d.deployment_key, a.arm_key
